company: Aero Aggregates Of North America LL
title: Plant Manager
text:
We are seeking a Plant Manager to join our growing team! You will oversee the activities of a production plant, milling operations, and site facilities.

Join our dynamic group and become part of a motivated team committed to making a meaningful impact in the industry, with resources to help you succeed and grow.

**Department**: Operations

**Reports** **to**: COO

**Responsibilities:**

* Assures production levels are maintained safely to schedule.
* Closely monitors all areas of production to ensure work is carried out to the highest standards.
* Assist staff on site in responding to any technical and/or staffing issues.
* Alters production in accordance with materials required.
* Manages the production process by setting and monitoring performance targets.
* Manages and regulates the budget.
* Provides information and updates on performance to senior managers as requested.
* Maintains up-to-date records to include inventory, inspection systems, checklists, and financials.
* Keeps abreast of key government health, safety, and environmental regulations, assuring they are implemented throughout the operation.
* Conducts regular site inspections to ensure compliance.
* Assesses equipment, orders new materials as required, and coordinates with internal and external maintenance to address plant and equipment readiness. Ensures all vehicles on site are maintained to a good standard.
* Provides training and development opportunities and works with the team to create development plans.

**Requirements:**

* The facility operates 24 hours a day / 7 days a week. The ability to respond outside of normal business hours is required.
* Ability to work a flexible shift when needed to include days, evenings, nights, and weekends.
* Regular and predictable attendance.
* Pre-employment screening, including drug screening and background check.
* 3+ years of supervision experience working in a manufacturing environment.
* Degree in Engineering or Science.
* Experience with change management.
* Previous use of a planned maintenance system.
* Experience with PLCs and automation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong analytical, leadership, and organizational skills.
* Proficient in MS Office Suite.

**Skills:**

* Results Driven: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
* Cultivate Innovation: Creating new and better ways for the Company to be successful
* Attracts & Develops talent: Attracting and selecting the best talent to meet current and future business needs. Develop people to meet both their career goals and the Company's goals.
* Collaborates: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
* Optimizes Work Processes: Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a strong focus on continuous improvement.
* Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources effectively and efficiently.
* Builds Effective Teams: Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.
* Manages Complexity: Making sense of complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.
